# is_manifest { #labdata.manifest.is_manifest }

```python
labdata.manifest.is_manifest(path)
```

Test whether a repository path is a manifest.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**path**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Repository-relative path.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   `True` for a manifest, which is never itself a published result file.
